en: A sepia-toned, vintage postcard showing a prominent corner building with elaborate architectural details typical of early 20th-century Central Europe. The building signage reads 'Gyulafehérvári Népbanka', and there are groups of people and children gathered on a cobblestone street. The setting is urban, with other period-appropriate buildings visible adjacent to it. The text is in Hungarian.
